description:
Sign and publish a Nostr DM as the patron, using the escrowed nsec.

The patron's escrowed nsec is loaded, decrypted in-process, used to
sign a kind-4 NIP-04 DM + a kind-1059 NIP-17 gift wrap, broadcast
via the operator's relay pool, then the plaintext drops out of
scope. The DM's `pubkey` is the patron's own — recipients see it
as authored by the patron, not relayed.

Returns {"success": True, "sender_npub", "target_npub"} on the
happy path; {"success": False, "error"} on validation or send
failure.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

target_npub.description: Nostr public key (npub1...) of the DM's recipient.

name: optionality_send_patron_dm
title: Send a Nostr DM
